event: The code only prints the value. The MCU side might check it, so I'll look there.

I verified the finding and submitted the verdict, which was accepted.

In `cptra_smoke_test_mcu_mbox_write_user_lock.c`, the step commented "Checking MBOX USER INFO" (lines 66–68) reads the USER register over AXI DMA. It then only prints the value with `VPRINTF`. Nothing compares it with an expected user, so this step cannot fail the test.

The MCU-side file (`smoke_test_mcu_mbox_write_user_lock.c`) writes to USER and checks that it did not change. That checks read-only behaviour, not the value the Caliptra side read, so it doesn't refute the finding.
